theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Goals Give Direction to Your Investments
body: Define your objectives first. Whether education, home, or retirement, clarity on timelines and amounts helps shape better investment choices.
caption: Every goal deserves a structured approach. Starting early and staying consistent transforms aspirations into reality. Let your objectives guide your investment journey. #GoalBasedInvesting #InvestmentStrategy #WealthBuilding #FutureReady #SmartInvesting
